text.description_html:
Fusion RH-C2, Navajo Trim Wall Mounted Robe Hook

The Stepped Scalloped Rose of the Navajo Robe Hook is ideal for southwest inspired decor. This wall mounted hook is not just good for keeping your bathrobe off of the floor, it is great for keeping all sorts of rooms in your home organized. Hans bags and outerwear near the front door or organize scarves and hats in the closet. It is available in antique copper, antique pewter, and oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-C2 Navajo Towel Bar, Fusion TR-C2 Navajo Towel Ring, and Fusion PH-C2 Navajo Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Southwest Navajo Robe Hook:

  • Mount Length: 4-3/4"
  • Mount Width: 2-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
